topic: Do glasses make your eyes weaker? Myth vs fact

youtube.title: Do glasses make your eyes weaker? 🤔 Myth vs Fact #Shorts
youtube.description:
Do glasses make your eyes weaker? The myth vs the fact.
கண்ணாடி போட்டால் கண் பலவீனமாகுமா?

• Myth: wearing glasses makes your power keep going up. Fact: glasses only bend light to focus it on the retina; they don't change your eye.
• In children, power changes because the eyeball is still growing, with or without glasses.
• After about 40, the lens inside the eye stiffens (presbyopia), so near reading gets harder for everyone.
• Skipping glasses doesn't make eyes 'stronger' — it only causes squinting, strain and headaches.
• In young children, not wearing needed glasses can affect how vision develops.
• Get children's eyes checked every year, adults regularly as your eye doctor advises.

gmb.text: Do glasses make your eyes weaker? This is a common myth. Glasses only bend light so it focuses on the retina; they do not change the shape or strength of your eye. Power changes in children because the eyeball is still growing, and after about 40 the lens inside the eye gets stiffer, which makes near reading harder. This happens with or without glasses. Skipping glasses only causes squinting and strain, and in young children not wearing needed glasses can affect how vision develops. Wear glasses as advised and get regular eye checks.
